messages:
Maria L.: Huge shoutout to @Devon and @Tia Chen for helping untangle the CI flake this morning — demo saved 🙌
Alex P.: ✨ legend status. Devon, how did you fix the test timeout?
Devon: Quick patch: reduced the mock delay and added `--no-cache` to the docker build in CI. Also cleared the flaky env var
Samir: Also thanks to Olivia R. for the quick rollback when logs spiked. Saved customers from weird errors :raised_hands:
Olivia R.: No prob — happy to help. Left a note in the deploy run: https://ci.internal/runs/12345
Tia Chen: @Maria L. glad it worked out. Team effort! :heart: Also coffee on me for whoever grabs the last bagel in kitchen :bagel:
Maria L.: I owe you a coffee, Tia ☕️
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollback to release v1.14.2 completed by @Olivia R. — 1789990060
Alex P.: Can we add a tiny test to cover that mock path? avoiding repeat misery :pray:
Devon: On it. Will open PR in a bit. tagging samir for review @Samir
Samir: I'll review — thanks for doing the quick follow-up. :ok_hand:
Maria L.: This is the kind of cross-team rescue I love. Anyone else to shout out?
Jordan K.: Also shoutout to infra-sig for bumping ephemeral capacity so staging didn't choke. 👏
Alex P.: lol that spike was wild — maybe we need an alert to auto-scale sooner
Tia Chen: Talking of alerts, can we make a quick ops doc? I can draft and ping SRE
Maria L.: Added to my to-do list. @Tia Chen please include the CI fix steps so others can run locally
Tia Chen: Will do. Also attaching a gif: https://giphy.com/gifs/thank-you-team-3oEjI6SIIHBdRxXI40
Olivia R.: :laughing: love it
Maria L.: :sparkles: big thanks everyone. Coffee bagel party at 11am? Vote :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no
Samir: :thumbsup:
Devon: :thumbsup:
Jordan K.: :thumbsup:
Alex P.: :thumbsdown: sadly in client calls, will skip but celebrate in spirit
Olivia R.: :thumbsup:
Tia Chen: If majority thumbs up, I'll put a sticky on kitchen whiteboard
Maria L.: Passing the shoutout baton 🏁 — let's keep this energy
